_comment: Phase 130.5 Plan 03 fixture corpus. A deterministic, frozen set of normalized papers per academic query that a stub fetchCorpus returns, so the migration regression in tests/test-130.5-corpus-migration.cjs is reproducible with ZERO network. fetched_at is a FIXED stamp (not new Date()) so the byte-identical compare between the old-path and migrated-path bundles is stable. The papers shape mirrors the rs-fetcher-academic normalized contract { id, title, abstract, authors[], institution, doi, source, fetched_at } that aggregateDocuments + fetcherExperts.mapExperts consume.
